about: 관리 > 일용근로 근무조회(E020751) — 원본(2026-10-14)처럼 줄은 전표마다 한 행: 2091/09/02 전표에 QA관리-일조A 2 (9/02) + QA관리-일조B 0.5 (9/01) 를 넣으면 '2091/09/02 -n · 2091/09/02 · QA관리-일조A 외 1건 · 일근무 · 2.00'(근무기록은 첫 줄 값), 9/03 전표 A 1 은 'QA관리-일조A · 1.00'. 사원 조건 B 만 → 줄 하나라도 맞는 9/02 전표만. 고른 줄 없이 [선택삭제] → '리스트에 선택된 자료가 없습니다.', 9/02 전표를 골라 지우면 그 행만 사라진다. 시험 자료는 지운다.

shots.name: 근무조회 — 전표마다 한 행 · 외 n건 · 선택삭제
steps: js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'};const mk=async n=>(await (await fetch('/api/hr/daily-workers',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({name:n,foreigner:false,employmentInsurance:true,pensionAuto:false,healthAuto:false,dailyWage:150000})})).json());const a=await mk('QA관리-일조A');const b=await mk('QA관리-일조B');const s1=await (await fetch('/api/hr/daily-work-entries',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({slipDate:'2091-09-02',lines:[{workDate:'2091-09-02',workerId:a.id,quantity:2},{workDate:'2091-09-01',workerId:b.id,quantity:0.5}]})})).json();const s2=await (await fetch('/api/hr/daily-work-entries',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({slipDate:'2091-09-03',lines:[{workDate:'2091-09-03',workerId:a.id,quantity:1}]})})).json();sessionStorage.setItem('qaDl',JSON.stringify({a:a.id,b:b.id,s1:s1.slipDate+'/'+s1.slipNo,s2:s2.slipDate+'/'+s2.slipNo,n1:s1.slipNo}));return true})()

expect:(()=>{const q=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qaDl'));const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr')].map(r=>r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim());return t.length===2&&t[1]==='2 2091/09/02 -'+q.n1+' 2091/09/02 QA관리-일조A 외 1건 일근무 2.00'&&t[0].includes('QA관리-일조A 일근무 1.00')})()
expect:(()=>{const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr')].map(r=>r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim());return t.length===1&&t[0].includes('QA관리-일조A 외 1건')})()

js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')};const q=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qaDl'));let ok=(await fetch('/api/hr/daily-work-entries/'+q.s2,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})).ok;for(const w of [q.a,q.b]){ok=(await fetch('/api/hr/daily-workers/'+w,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})).ok&&ok}sessionStorage.setItem('qaDlClean',String(ok));return true})()
